blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Boundary delineation of anatomical structures in prostate MRI is often compromised by regional ambiguity. Automated segmentation methods relying on global overlap loss functions tend to be insensitive to surface deviations, leading to significant errors in ambiguous regions. Most existing uncertainty-aware methods treat uncertainty as a post-hoc quality indicator or prediction filter. We propose Contrastive Uncertainty Learning (CUL), a supervised framework that uses predictive uncertainty to directly guide representation learning. Using Monte Carlo Dropout, CUL identifies voxel-wise uncertainty and structures the embedding geometry accordingly: low-uncertainty, correctly predicted features form stable voxels while high-uncertainty or misclassified features are actively repelled, preventing feature collapse at difficult boundaries. We evaluate CUL on a 589-scan 3D prostate MRI multi-structure segmentation task (8 anatomical structures) using a ViT with UperNet decoder architecture. Average Dice ($83.38\%$) remains comparable to the baseline ($83.35\%$), while surface distance decreases significantly ($p<0.001$) across 6 of 8 anatomical structures. A hard-case analysis reveals a $22{\times}$ asymmetry between significantly improved and degraded cases ($18.8\%$ vs $0.9\%$). Ablation studies show that removing uncertainty-guided sample selection eliminates improvements for the transition zone, while replacing the contrastive objective with a boundary loss additionally removes bladder improvements, demonstrating that both uncertainty-guided sampling and the contrastive objective are essential for the observed gains. These findings demonstrate that the proposed uncertainty-guided representation learning is a useful mechanism for reducing the risk of extreme errors in safety-critical medical segmentation
blocks.zh: 前列腺核磁共振中解剖结构的划界往往受到区域模糊性的影响。 依赖全球重叠损失功能的自动分割方法往往对表面偏差不敏感,导致模糊区域出现重大错误。 大多数现有的不确定性意识方法将不确定性作为热后质量指标或预测过滤器处理. 我们建议采用对比不确定性学习(CulL),这是一个监督框架,利用预测不确定性直接指导代表性学习。 使用Monte Carlo Dropout,CUL识别了voxel-wise的不确定性,并据此构建嵌入几何:低不确定性,正确预测的特征形成稳定的voxel,而高不确定性或错分类的特征则被积极击退,防止特征在困难边界下崩溃. 我们使用带有UperNet解码器架构的ViT,对589扫描3D前列腺核磁共振多结构分解任务(8个解剖结构)进行CUL评价. 平均剂量(83.38美元)仍与基线值(83.35美元)相当,8个解剖结构中的6个结构的表面距离(p<0.001美元)则大幅下降。 硬案例分析显示,在明显改善的病例和退化的病例之间有22美元不对称(18.8美元对0.9美元)。 差异研究显示,消除不确定性引导样本选择消除了过渡带的改善,而以边界损失取代对比目标,进一步消除了膀胱的改善,表明不确定性引导取样和对比目标对观察到的收益至关重要。 这些调查结果表明,拟议的以不确定性为指南的表述方式学习是减少安全关键医疗隔离中极端错误风险的有用机制。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Deep learning based segmentation is becoming important for quantitative analysis of prostate MRI, enabling automated delineation of prostate zones and associated structures for prostate cancer diagnosis, risk stratification, and treatment planning [ 1 ] . Despite strong average performance, convolutional and transformer models often fail on boundary ambiguous cases, producing large boundary deviations that are not fully reflected by global overlap metrics [ 2 ] . A key challenge lies in learning representations that remain robust in regions of high predictive uncertainty, typically near boundaries where standard losses such as Dice or cross-entropy do not explicitly incorporate confidence information.
blocks.zh: 对前列腺核磁共振的定量分析而言,深入的以学习为基础的分化正变得十分重要,从而能够自动划分前列腺区和前列腺癌诊断、风险分层和治疗规划的相关机构。 尽管平均性能很强,但在边界模棱两可的情况下,转录和变压器模型往往会出故障,产生巨大的边界偏差,而全球重叠度量表并没有充分反映这一点[2]. 关键的挑战在于在预测不确定性高的区域,通常在靠近边界的地方,学习仍然很强势的表示,因为Dice等标准损失或交叉接触没有明确包含信心信息。

blocks.en: Predictive uncertainty estimates represent model confidence and are widely used in medical image analysis. Bayesian approximations, including Monte Carlo dropout [ 3 ] and deep ensembles [ 4 ] , correlate uncertainty with segmentation error and support quality assurance, error detection, and selective prediction in safety-critical applications.
blocks.zh: 预测性不确定性估计代表模型置信度,被广泛用于医学图像分析. 贝叶斯语近似值,包括Monte Carlo退出[3]和深层组合[4],将不确定性与分化误差联系起来,支持质量保证,出错检测,以及安全关键应用中的选择性预测.

blocks.en: Uncertainty has also been incorporated into training strategies, particularly in semi-supervised segmentation. In teacher–student frameworks, uncertainty is used to filter unreliable pseudo-labels or weight consistency losses to mitigate confirmation bias [ 5 ] . Uncertainty guided contrastive learning similarly excludes high uncertainty pixels from positive pair construction to stabilise representations [ 6 , 7 ] . Prototype based and memory based approaches construct class prototypes from confident regions while preventing ambiguous voxels from contaminating cluster centres [ 8 ] . These methods improve robustness when labelled data are limited, using uncertainty as a filtering or weighting mechanism.
blocks.zh: 不确定性也被纳入了培训战略,特别是在半监督分区方面。 在师生框架中,不确定性被用来过滤不可靠的伪标签或重量一致性损失来缓解确认偏差[5]. 不确定性引导的对比性学习同样排除了高不确定性像素从正对构造到稳定表示 [6, 7]. 基于原型和基于记忆的方法构建了来自自信区域的类原型,同时防止模棱两可的花瓶污染集群中心[8]. 在贴有标签的数据有限时,这些方法将不确定性用作过滤或加权机制,从而提高了稳健性。

blocks.en: Directly using uncertainty to structure embedding geometry in fully supervised segmentation remains underexplored, particularly for intrinsically ambiguous multi-structure MRI segmentation.
blocks.zh: 直接利用不确定性将几何结构嵌入到完全监督的分解中,仍然没有得到充分利用,特别是对于内在模糊的多结构磁共振分解而言。

blocks.en: Contrastive learning provides a principled mechanism for structuring representation space. Self-supervised frameworks such as MoCo [ 9 ] , SimCLR [ 10 ] , and supervised contrastive learning [ 11 ] demonstrate their ability to shape embeddings. Contrastive learning at the pixel and voxel levels has been adopted in segmentation to enhance intra-class compactness and inter-class separation. However, these methods typically define positive pairs solely by class identity or spatial proximity, without considering predictive confidence.
blocks.zh: 相互矛盾的学习为构建代表空间提供了原则机制。 由MoCo[9],SimCLR[10]等自我监督的框架,以及被监督的对比性学习[11],显示了它们塑造嵌入的能力. 在分化中采用了像素和活性水平的矛盾学习,以加强阶级内部紧凑性和阶级间分化. 然而,这些方法通常仅通过类特征或空间相近来定义正对,而不考虑预测性信心.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of the proposed Contrastive Uncertainty Learning (CUL) framework. Prostate MRI is processed by a segmentation network to produce voxel wise predictions and an associated uncertainty map. Voxel embeddings are partitioned into low and high uncertainty regions and used to construct contrastive pairs. Low-uncertainty same-class features are pulled together, while high-uncertainty or misclassified features are repelled, improving boundary robustness.
blocks.zh: 图1:拟议对比不确定性学习框架概览。 前列腺核磁共振由分解网络进行处理,以产生出活塞智慧的预测和相关的不确定性图. Voxel嵌入被分出为低和高不确定性区域并用于构建对比对. 低不确定性同级地物被拉拢,而高不确定性或错分类地物被击退,提高了边界坚固性.

blocks.en: 2.2 Contrastive Uncertainty Learning (CUL)
blocks.zh: 2.2 矛盾不确定性的学习

blocks.en: Uncertainty Guided Sampling and Pair Construction:

Using the uncertainty map, CUL operates on decoder features (before the final classifier), which are projected into a contrastive embedding space. We first define the low-uncertainty mask and prediction-error map: M low = ( U ~ < τ ) , E map = ( y ^ ≠ y ) , \displaystyle M_{\text{low}}=\mathbf{1}\!\left(\tilde{U}<\tau\right),~E_{\text{map}}=\mathbf{1}\!\left(\hat{y}\neq y\right), (1) where τ ( = 0.5 ) \tau(=0.5) is a fixed uncertainty threshold and y ^ \hat{y} is the predicted label.
From these, we define an anchor pool and a negative pool: M anchor = M low ⋅ ( 1 − E map ) , M neg = ( ( 1 − M low ) + E map > 0 ) . \displaystyle M_{\text{anchor}}=M_{\text{low}}\cdot(1-E_{\text{map}}),~M_{\text{neg}}=\mathds{1}\!\left((1-M_{\text{low}})+E_{\text{map}}>0\right). (2)

Terminology: Anchors are voxels ( e p e_{p} ) sampled from decoder features using the mask M anchor M_{\text{anchor}} , corresponding to low-uncertainty and correctly predicted regions. For each anchor, a positive sample is defined as a same-class voxel drawn from the anchor pool, excluding the anchor itself when possible. Negatives ( e n e_{n} ) are sampled using M neg M_{\text{neg}} , comprising voxels that are either high-uncertainty or misclassified, and are not restricted to different-class locations.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 3 实验和结果

blocks.en: Dataset and Experimental Setup: For our experiments, we employ a multi-institute pelvis MR dataset [ 14 ] , consisting of 589 T2W 3D MRI input samples of size (D=64, H=256, W=256) with anatomy/zone masks. In total, there are 8 anatomical structures; bladder, bone, obturator internus, central gland, transition zone, rectum, seminal vescicle and neurovascular bundle. The dataset was split into train, validation and test sets (412, 60, 117) and the inputs were preprocessed and augmented using standard preprocessing and augmentation (centre cropping, rotation, flipping, zooming and intensity normalisation). Training used an NVIDIA A40 GPU for 100 epochs with learning rate 1 ​ e − 4 1e-4 . The Dice with cross entropy loss was adopted to train our baseline segmentation model using the Adam optimiser. Batch size was set to 4 with 5 Monte Carlo (MC) samples computed for the uncertainty map during training. For performance evaluation, we use Dice, Hausdorff-distance and Surface Distance, capturing the overall overlap as well as worst-case boundary errors and surface errors. To isolate each component’s contribution, we evaluate two ablations under identical training conditions: a class-based variant replacing uncertainty-guided anchor selection with ground-truth class identity only; and a boundary loss variant replacing the contrastive term with a Kervadec-style distance-transform boundary loss.
blocks.zh: 数据集和实验设置 : 对于我们的实验,我们使用多组骨盆MR数据集[14],由589个大小(D=64,H=256,W=256)的T2W 三维磁共振输入样品组成,并带有解剖学/区口罩. 总计有8个解剖结构;膀胱,骨骼,偏振性间核,中腺,过渡区,直肠,基质花序和神经血管捆绑. 数据集被分为列车,验证和测试集(412,60,117),投入采用标准预处理和增强(中心裁剪,旋转,翻转,放大和强度正常化)进行预处理和增强. 培训在100个学期使用NVIDIA A40 GPU,学习率为1-4 1e-4。 使用Adam Opimiser来训练我们的基线分解模型。 批量大小被设定为4个,其中5个Monte Carlo(MC)样本在培训期间为不确定地图所计算。 在性能评价方面,我们使用Dice,Hausdorff-travel和Surface Starge,捕捉总体重叠以及最坏的边界误差和表面误差. 为了孤立每个组成部分的贡献,我们评价了两个相同的训练条件下的拼接:一个基于班级的变体,仅以地面-真实班级身份取代不确定导锚选择;一个边界损失变体,以Kervadec风格的远距离-变形分界线损失取而代之。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Overall segmentation performance for Baseline, CUL, and the two ablations. SD(mm) is significantly improved which is consistent with CUL’s design: predictive uncertainty concentrates at local boundary regions, so improvement manifests in surface-sensitive metrics rather than in global overlap (Dice) or gross deviation extremes (HD95(mm)).
blocks.zh: 表1:基线、CUL和两个集合的总体分解性能。 SD(mm)得到显著改进,这与CUL的设计一致:预测不确定性集中在地界区域,因此改进表现在地表敏感度的度量,而不是全球重叠(Dice)或总偏差极(HD95(mm)).

blocks.en: Overall Quantitative Performance: Table 1 summarises overall segmentation performance across 117 test cases. CUL achieves comparable Dice performance to the baseline (0.8338 vs 0.8335), indicating that uncertainty-aware contrastive learning does not on average degrade global overlap. As CUL specifically focuses on boundary deviations, we observe consistent improvement in boundary sensitive metrics. Mean HD95 decreases from 5.93 mm to 5.41 mm, and mean surface distance (SD) decreases from 1.61 mm to 1.42 mm.
blocks.zh: 总体数量 绩效:表1汇总了117个测试案例的整体分化性能. CUL实现与基线(0.8338对0.8335)相可比较的Dice性能,表明对不确定性的认识对比性学习平均不会降低全球重叠. 由于CUL特别侧重于边界偏差,我们看到边界敏感度指标的不断改进. 平均HD95从5.93毫米降至5.41毫米,平均地表距离从1.61毫米降至1.42毫米。

blocks.en: The HD95 standard deviation is notably reduced (8.14 → 4.88 mm), suggesting suppression of extreme outliers, though formal variance testing (Brown-Forsythe p = 0.538 p{=}0.538 ) does not confirm this at α = 0.05 \alpha{=}0.05 , likely reflecting limited statistical power at n = 117 n=117 ; we therefore treat it as a descriptive finding. Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank testing confirms that SD reduction is statistically significant ( p < 0.0001 p{<}0.0001 ), while Dice ( p < 0.181 p{<}0.181 ) and HD95 ( p < 0.816 p{<}0.816 ) median shifts are not. Dice is expected to remain unchanged because CUL targets local boundary uncertainty rather than volumetric overlap. Although HD95 is not significant, its mean decreases by 0.49 mm and variance is descriptively reduced, suggesting suppression of extreme outliers despite limited statistical power.
blocks.zh: HD95标准偏差明显减少(8.14 — 4.88毫米),表明抑制了极端偏差,但正式差异测试(Brown-Forsythe p = 0.538 p = 0.538)在α = 0.05\alpha = 0.05 时没有证实这一点,可能反映n = 117 n = 117 的统计力有限;因此,我们把它当作一个描述性结论。 Paired Wilcoxon签名的名牌测试证实自毁还原值在统计学上是显著的(p < 0.0001 p{<}0.0001),而Dice(p < 0.181 p{<}0.181)和HD95(p < 0.816 p{<}0.816)中位值的转会则不是. 由于CUL针对的是局部边界的不确定性,而不是体积相重叠,因此预计会保持不变. 虽然HD95并不显著,但其平均减少0.49毫米并呈描述性地缩小了差异,这表明尽管统计力量有限,但极端外部因素仍然受到压制。

blocks.en: Case-Wise Performance Distribution: To characterise model behaviour beyond aggregate statistics, we analyse per-case performance (Table 2 ) across 117 test cases. A case is classified as notably improved or degraded if its mean metric change across all 8 structures exceeds a fixed medically critical absolute threshold (SD: ± \pm 0.1 mm; HD95: ± \pm 0.5 mm). Dice improves in 54.7 % 54.7\% of cases versus 45.3 % 45.3\% degraded, indicating only a modest net overlap gain. In contrast, boundary-sensitive metrics show clear asymmetry. HD95 improves in 56.4 % 56.4\% of cases (+15 net), while SD improves in 67.5 % 67.5\% of cases (+41 net). When considering significant changes, SD exhibits strong directional bias: 18.8 % 18.8\% of cases show significant reduction compared to only 0.9 % 0.9\% significant increase (22 vs 1 cases). This 22× ratio suggests asymmetric boundary refinement rather than random fluctuation. Figure 2 demonstrates the case where CUL has improved the boundary uncertainty the most (HD95=17.11 vs 4.09) and also the most degraded case (HD95=10.97 vs 12.80).
blocks.zh: Case-Wise 性能分布: 为了确定超出总体统计的模型行为的特点,我们分析了117个测试案例的个案业绩(表2)。 如果一个案例在所有8个结构中的平均计量变化超过固定的医疗临界绝对阈值(SD:±\pm 0.1毫米;HD95:±\pm 0.5毫米),则被归类为显著改进或退化. 在54.7%的病例和45.3%的45.3%的病例中,剂量有所改善,表明净重叠收益不大。 相比之下,对边界敏感的衡量标准显示出明显的不对称. HD95改进了56.4%的病例(+15个净额),而SD改进了67.5%的病例(+41个净额)。 在考虑重大变化时,可持续性发展呈现出强烈的方向性偏差:18.8%的个案显示显著减少,而只有0.9%.0.9%.大幅增加(22起对1起)。 这种22×相比表示不对称的边界改进而不是随机波动. 图2显示了CUL改善边界不确定性的情况(HD95=17.11 vs 4.09),以及退化程度最高的案件(HD95=10.97 vs 12.80)。

blocks.en: Hard-Case Robustness Analysis: We stratify cases using the median baseline HD95 threshold (4.00) to distinguish easy and hard subsets (Table 3 ). CUL achieves the largest boundary improvement in hard cases, with a mean HD95 reduction of 1.113 mm, whereas easy cases exhibit only marginal change ( OPEN ≈ 0 ) \approx 0) .
blocks.zh: 硬案强力 分析: 我们使用中位基线HD95阈值(4.00)对病例进行分层,以区分简单和硬子集(表3)。 CUL在硬壳中实现了最大的边界改进,平均HD95还原为1.113毫米,而简单壳只显示出微小的变化(OPEN ≈ 0)\约0.

blocks.en: Structure-wise Analysis: Table 4 reports mean surface distance per anatomical structure (paired Wilcoxon, α = 0.05 \alpha{=}0.05 ). CUL achieves significant SD improvement in 6/8 structures:bladder, bone, central gland, rectum, transition zone, and neurovascular bundle. Obturator internus and seminal vesicle show no significant change;both have inter-subject variance exceeding three times their mean, suggesting high case to case variability. Dice remains largely unchanged across all structures( | Δ | < 0.004 |\Delta|{<}0.004 ). HD95 reaches significance only for rectum ( p = 0.004 p{=}0.004 ). Notably, the largest quantitative SD gains appear in bone( − 0.16 -0.16 mm) and central gland( − 0.61 -0.61 mm).
blocks.zh: 结构分析:表4报告指每个解剖结构的表面距离(paired Wilcoxon, α = 0.05\alpha{=}0.05)。 CUL在6/8结构中实现了显著的自毁改进:被子,骨,中腺,直肠,过渡区和神经血管捆绑. 受试者间核和有原动力的活体显示没有重大变化;两者的受试者间差异都超过其平均值的3倍,表明情况可变性很大。 在所有结构中,水滴基本上没有变化(  Δ < 0.004 |\ Delta * 0.004). HD95只对直肠具有意义(p = 0.004 p * 0.004)。 值得注意的是,最大的定量自毁增量出现在骨(−0.16-0.16毫米)和中腺(−0.61-0.61毫米)。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Qualitative comparison between an improved case (top) and a degraded case (bottom). The top row highlights CUL’s role as geometric “insurance”, where it effectively corrects extreme boundary outliers in cases characterised by high regional ambiguity (e.g. central gland and both neurovascular bundles). CUL organises representations to stabilise boundaries by anchoring confident regions and isolating ambiguity. This visualisation demonstrates the framework’s capacity to correct significant spatial deviations while maintaining the integrity of stable predictions.
blocks.zh: 图2 改进病例(上)和退化病例(下)之间的定性比较。 顶部一行突出CUL作为几何 " 保险 " 的作用,在区域模糊度高(如中腺和神经血管捆绑)的情况下,它有效地纠正了极端的边界外因素。 CUL组织演示,通过锚定自信区域和隔离模糊来稳定边界. 这种可视化显示了框架在保持稳定预测完整性的同时纠正显著空间偏差的能力.

blocks.en: Ablation Study: To isolate the contribution of each CUL component, Table 4 also reports the two ablations. The class-based ablation (uncertainty guided selection removed) reaches 5/8 significant structures, failing only on transition zone ( p = 0.676 p{=}0.676 ) which CUL improves ( p = 0.002 p{=}0.002 ). This shows uncertainty guidance provides additional benefit beyond class-based contrastive learning. The boundary loss ablation reaches only 4/8, additionally failing to improve bladder ( p = 0.115 p{=}0.115 ), suggesting geometric loss augmentation cannot replicate uncertainty-guided contrastive structuring. The stepwise pattern, CUL 6/8 > class-based 5/8 > boundary loss 4/8, isolates uncertainty guided sample selection as the decisive factor for transition zone, and the contrastive mechanism as the decisive factor for bladder.
blocks.zh: 读取研究: 为了孤立每个单元的贡献,表4还报告了两个因素。 基于类的通缩(被移除的不确定导取)达到了5/8个重要结构,只在过渡区(p = 0.676 p = 0.676)上失败,而CUL改进了(p = 0.002 p = 0.002). 这表明了不确定性导取超出基于类的对比性学习之外的额外好处. 边界损耗只达到4/8,另外未能改善膀胱(p = 0.115 p = 0.115),说明几何损耗增殖无法复制以不确定性为指向的对比结构. 相继模式 CUL 6/8 > 类基 5/8 > 边界损失 4/8,将不确定性导引样本选择作为过渡带的决定性因素,对比机制作为膀胱的决定性因素.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 讨论和结论

blocks.en: For our multi-structure MRI segmentation, we propose a supervised contrastive framework for improving geometric robustness, by estimating predictive uncertainty as a representation-level supervisory signal.
blocks.zh: 对于我们的多结构核磁共振分解,我们提出了一个有监督的对比性框架,通过估计预测不确定性作为代表级监督信号来改进几何稳健性。

blocks.en: Our experiments on a multi-organ prostate MRI segmentation task show that CUL maintains comparable global overlap performance to the baseline, while consistently improving boundary-sensitive metrics. Case-wise and difficulty-stratified analyses further reveal that CUL yields the strongest benefits on hard cases characterised by large boundary deviations. Moreover, comparison with the two ablations clarifies the source of these gains, isolating the uncertainty guided mechanism as the key driver of CUL’s improvements in the transition zone.
blocks.zh: 我们关于多器官前列腺核磁共振分解任务的实验表明,CUL保持与基线相似的全球重叠性能,同时不断改进对边界敏感的度量. 根据具体情况和困难程度进行的分析进一步表明,CUL在以重大边界偏差为特点的硬性案例中产生最大的效益。 此外,与这两起事件相比,澄清了这些收益的来源,孤立了以不确定性为导向的机制,作为团结会改善过渡区的主要动力。

blocks.en: These improvements have practical implications for radiotherapy planning. In pelvic organ segmentation, surface distance errors of even a few millimetres can translate to incorrect planning target volume (PTV) margins, affecting dose coverage and organ at risk (OAR) sparing. Similar precision requirements are of importance for targeted biopsy and focal therapy. The significant SD reductions, directly targets the boundary precision that affects contour acceptance in clinical workflows. The 22× asymmetry between significant improvements and significant degradations in SD further suggests CUL reduces the tail of outlier errors that typically require manual re-contouring. Future work includes adaptive uncertainty thresholding, additional ablations, and integration with multi-scale, domain-robust training.
blocks.zh: 这些改进对放射治疗规划具有实际影响. 在盆腔器官分化中,即使是几毫米的地表距离差会转化为规划目标量(PTV)偏差,影响剂量覆盖和有危险的器官(OAR)的分出. 类似的精确要求对于有针对性的活检和焦距疗法也很重要. 大幅自毁还原,直接针对影响临床工作流程中等同接受的边界精度. 22× SD中显著改进和显著退化之间的不对称进一步表明CUL会减少通常需要人工再相接的出错的尾部. 今后的工作包括适应性不确定性阈值的确定、额外的活化,以及与多规模、域-活性培训相结合。
